after: Phase 17 canonical glyph images and direct cache entries; production source hashes below

protocol.timing: wall time for CPU layout/recording where specified, native submission and explicit GPU wait; compilation/font loading/readback excluded
protocol.pixels: exact initial, first two mutated and final images in every case/round; retained nested text additionally matches independently recorded immediate geometry before/after each round

workloads.shared_text_scene: 1280x800, bundled Noto Sans Regular and Noto Color Emoji CBDT; 30 lines, 16px text/24px line height, 1200x760 buffer, no wrap, dark background, white text. Ordinary line: Tileink Market Watch 0123456789 — cached text, scalable outlines & glyphs. Color line: Tileink 😀 Market 0123456789 — Color 😀 glyphs. Re-recorded origins cycle four quarter-pixel X positions.
workloads.text_cached: Renders the same unchanged prepared Canvas; layout/recording excluded.
workloads.text_layout_rgb: Extract unchanged caller-owned Cosmic Buffer layout, record new Canvas and render every frame, RGB.
workloads.text_layout_alpha: Same actual layout/record/render workload, single-channel alpha.
workloads.text_cache_invalidation: Clear TextContext caches each frame, extract buffer layout, re-record and render; includes rerasterization and atlas generation changes.
workloads.text_path_outline: Extract buffer layout, record scalable glyph outlines as paths, render every frame; exercises outline cache hits.
workloads.text_color_emoji: Mixed ordinary/color glyph layout extraction, re-recording and rendering.
workloads.retained_nested_text_revisions: 128 retained leaves; replace one nested appended text Canvas per frame, alternate one/four-line variants per 128 mutations; independent immediate reference.
workloads.ordinary_control: Unchanged ordinary nontext workload from previous cleanup rounds.

interpretation: Layout and outline-recording workload medians decrease in both rounds. Cached text, retained mutations and the nontext control vary slightly; this does not establish a general renderer speedup. No material regression identified in these affected workloads.
